title: Inference Optimal Long Run Variance Estimation with Lugsail Kernels
summary: For datasets with unknown but stationary serial dependence, a robust long run variance estimator is essential to handle diverse scenarios. Spectral variance estimators are commonly used but tend to exhibit significant negative bias in the presence of positive correlation. To overcome this, zero lugsail estimators have been introduced, offering zero asymptotic bias regardless of the correlation structure.
